reason: newline='' is load-bearing. read_text() translates CRLF to LF, so rewriting one number in a CRLF file rewrote every line ending: a one-digit change arrived as a whole-file diff on Windows. Read and write untranslated and splice the line in place ('Stop rewriting line endings on update').

    lines = fh.read().splitlines(keepends=True)
